title: Saint Albans Historical Museum

services.name: Digital Exhibits
services.desc: Discover new voices and stories as we explore the people, places, and events that define our community. These galleries can take you back in time anytime, anywhere! Each exhibit is presented in two formats: a full-color PDF and an accessible PDF featuring ultra-legible fonts, a high-contrast color scheme, and tags for compatibility with screen readers. As part of SAM’s ongoing diversity, equity, accessibility, and inclusion efforts, we set out to highlight the often-overlooked perspectives of Black Vermonters in St. Albans and Franklin County.
